SyncResponse.description: Everything of the user's that changed after `since`, including deletions.
SyncResponse.title: SyncResponse

get.description: The built-in catalog plus the user's own exercises.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the exercise; past workouts keep showing it.

put.description: Creates or replaces one of the user's own exercises.

delete.description:
Deletes the signed-in user's account and all of their data.

The Clerk user is deleted by the client afterwards (web and iOS call Clerk's
`user.delete()`), so the API never needs the Clerk secret key. If that step
fails, the next sign-in simply starts a new, empty account.

put.description: Creates the profile or replaces all of its fields.
Creates or replaces the summary for one local date.

get.description:
Returns up to `limit` of the user's records changed after `since`, deletions included.

Store the returned `change_seq` and send it as `since` next time. While `has_more`
is true, call again right away. `since=0` starts from the beginning. The built-in
catalog comes from GET /v1/exercises and GET /v1/templates instead.

Every change takes a unique value of the user's counter, so a page ends exactly at
the `limit`-th change and the next page starts after it.
Built-in templates plus the user's own.

put.description: Creates or completely replaces one of the user's own templates.

get.description: Newest first. Pass `next_before` from a page as `before` to get the next page.

put.description:
Creates the workout or replaces it completely, exercises and sets included.

Sending the same body again gives the same result, so the app can retry safely.
